result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M when Kubient handles Customer or visitor data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing general provisions. However, requiring all coverage—including CGL and workers’ compensation—for one year after the Term exceeds the playbook and is broader than necessary; any post-termination requirement should ordinarily be limited to applicable claims-made coverages.
